doc: Frozen methods shown on matched complete Doc cohorts. X includes actual visual payload, metadata, lookup, positions and charged encoder constants; the 1.8-bit limit is a cap, not the point coordinate. Full is a mean-quality reference at its stated >16-bit owner and is not plotted as a <=1.8-bit candidate. Error bars are marginal document-cluster bootstrap intervals, not paired difference intervals. The faint frontier is only the nondominated set among displayed frozen methods; no superiority over the strong gradient baseline is implied.
text: New-image single-model transfer with Doc-frozen methods and no Text recalibration. Points are official ten-annotator MMF/TextVQA soft accuracy; horizontal intervals are image-cluster 95% bootstrap intervals. The separate right column reports each method actual complete bit cost, including Full; scores are not ANLS and do not establish multi-model generality.
mechanism: Descriptive local counterfactuals on the fixed-query 16-document collection, with prefill and decode kept separate. Score numerator is all visual-score error SSE, including common offsets, normalized by centered Full-score SSE. Output error combines all query heads through W_O and includes the unchanged V1 readout error as well as K-induced effects. Current Full queries/text are identical across candidates; candidate states are not committed. Materialized projection references do not represent low-bit deployment owners. No sampling interval is invented from the aggregate table, and these local points are not predictions of final ANLS or student-trajectory error.
